escalations.question: Walmart sales lead wrote on 2026-10-03 (EM-0001) that $4.50/case was agreed for TP-0214, with no signed amendment on file. DD-0242 claims 2026-09 at $4.50/case. TP-0214 as we hold it says $4.20/case (AM-02#4.2). Which is the source of truth? I'd recommend: hold until more evidence arrives. An email is not an agreement: TP-0214 as signed doesn't support this, and the Walmart sales lead, who negotiated TP-0214, can't approve a claim on their own deal. Hold until the signed amendment arrives; when it does, the engine reads it and restates the months it reaches.
